source: Written for VPM to the upstream package's API and behavior. Emotion's tests are retained in scripts/emotion-conformance/upstream (repository commit 49229553967b6050c92d9602eb577bdc48167e91, tag @emotion/styled@11.14.1).
changes: Written for VPM: createCache, Emotion's stylis plugins (compat, removeLabel and the development alarms) and its prefixer, on vstylis (stylis 4.4.0) instead of stylis 4.2.0, vemotion-sheet, vemotion-memoize and vemotion-weak-memoize.
compat splits selectors with its own scanner instead of stylis's module-global tokenizer.

The prefixer selects properties by name with Emotion's rule set (stylis's rules without grid prefixing): the original's copy of stylis 4.0.13's prefixer selected them by a hash of the name's length and first four characters, so properties sharing a hash got invented declarations (flex-wrap gained -webkit-box-flex-wrap, color-scheme -webkit-print-color-scheme).
align-self gives IE's -ms-flex-item-align a valid keyword (the original wrote flex-start), and justify-content: space-between keeps -ms-flex-pack:justify (the original's pattern removed it).
The prefixer is exported for combining with other plugins.
The #is-development and #is-browser conditions choose development or production and browser or server behavior, as in the original's conditional builds.

verification.upstreamSuite: Emotion's 293 tests pass with this package in place of the original, in development and production builds and with React 16 and React 18.
verification.differential: compare-cache.cjs: 10,000 generated styles as classes and global styles, in regular and compat mode, give the same CSS, inserted state and messages as @emotion/cache 11.14.0 (on stylis 4.4.0) with no plugins, the default prefixer and VentiMath's two configurations (stylis-plugin-rtl 2.1.1 and its @layer plugin), in development and production, on Node and Bun.
verification.declarations: types.cjs compiles an application against the declarations with DOM types under the configured TypeScript 7 compiler.
